verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party pricing documentation. Community comments only imply usage-based billing: one quotes a cost of more than $58/month for 1 vCPU and 1 GiB "when used continuously", another cites a per-vCPU price, and a third notes containers auto-shut down when idle, which suggests you pay for active use rather than a reserved instance. Missing for 10: first-party docs on per-second billing granularity, confirmation that idle or stopped sandboxes are not billed, a breakdown of compute vs. memory metering, and independent hands-on billing corroboration.
